# SAMA Energia

> Status: English summary written for AI crawlers and answer engines. This file is not
> customer-facing copy: the customer-facing content is in Finnish (samaenergia.fi) and
> Estonian (samaenergia.ee). The full text of every public page in both languages is in
> https://samaenergia.fi/llms-full.txt (generated from the same HTML that is served).

SAMA Energia Oy (Finnish business ID 3647683-3, VAT FI36476833, domiciled in
Helsinki, Finland) is an integrator (EPC) of industrial battery energy storage
and solar PV for businesses and landowners in Finland and Estonia. The company
surveys, designs, procures and builds the systems and connects them to the
reserve markets of the transmission system operators Fingrid (Finland) and
Elering (Estonia) through an aggregator. Founders: Martin Rautio (CEO) and
Madis Maastik (sales director). Site updated 3 September 2026 (design v5).

What the company says about itself, in its own documented positioning:

- One battery, four jobs: peak shaving of the grid capacity charge, buying
  electricity in cheap spot-price hours, reserve-market income for standing
  ready, and backup power. No solar or own generation is required; an existing
  grid connection is enough.
- Reserve markets (FFR, FCR-N, FCR-D, aFRR, mFRR in Finland; FCR, aFRR, mFRR in
  Estonia) pay for availability. A single industrial battery reaches the market
  through an aggregator: VENI Energia in Finland, Soleron Energy in Estonia.
  Backup power requires an installation designed for island operation and a
  separated critical circuit; it is assessed site by site.
- Reserve income is never guaranteed: the written assessment shows a low, medium
  and high scenario, and keeps the capacity-charge and spot-price savings on a
  separate line because they do not depend on reserve prices.
- The first product is a free site survey and a written assessment: every figure
  with its source and date, the customer's own hourly consumption data as the
  basis, the distribution grid operator's position before any capital is
  committed, financing shown as own capital versus leasing on the same figures.
  A reply within two business days.
- Delivery partners named on the site: Ralos Oy (battery units, stock in
  Tampere) and JSM Automaatiosähkö Oy (electrical installation and commissioning).
  Financing is not tied to any single provider: leasing can be arranged through
  business financiers in Finland and Estonia and is compared with own capital on
  the same figures in the written assessment.
- Sources cited on the site include Fingrid's reserve-market material (e.g.
  "Energiavarastot reservimarkkinoilla", 10 February 2025: share of prequalified
  capacity from energy storage FCR-N 29 %, FCR-D 13 % up / 18 % down, FFR 54 %),
  Fingrid's 24 September 2025 release on connection restrictions in southern
  Finland until 2029, and Elering's balancing-capacity cost (3.73 EUR/MWh in
  2026, 2.97 EUR/MWh from 2027).
- Privacy posture: no cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts, fonts
  self-hosted. The contact form is the only place personal data is collected.

- https://samaenergia.fi/ : Front page — "Itsenäinen energia. Itseohjautuva akku." One battery, three cash flows plus backup power; how the four steps work; who it suits; FAQ; site-survey form.

- https://samaenergia.fi/energiavarastot/ : Industrial energy storage: one device, four jobs; a battery's day; what is delivered and why now.
- https://samaenergia.fi/reservimarkkinat/ : Reserve markets explained; four sourced reasons; how income is estimated; honest about reserve prices; what the company votes for.
- https://samaenergia.fi/veni-energia/ : What an aggregator does, how joining Fingrid's reserve markets proceeds, and the Finnish aggregator partner VENI Energia.
- https://samaenergia.fi/palvelut/ : Services — free site survey, written assessment, project management, monitoring; the four rules of every assessment.
- https://samaenergia.fi/meista/ : About — why the company was founded, who is accountable for what, the partner network, company facts.
- https://samaenergia.fi/ajankohtaista/ : Reviews with sources and dates.
- https://samaenergia.fi/ajankohtaista/liityntarajoitus-2029/ : Review: no new storage connections in southern Finland before 2029 — your connection already exists.
- https://samaenergia.fi/yhteystiedot/ : Contact and free site survey request.
- https://samaenergia.fi/tietosuoja/ : Privacy statement (no cookies, no analytics).
